# Verify that go bug populates the 00-bug.yml issue form query parameters.

[!GOOS:linux] skip
[short] skip

go install
go build -o $TMPDIR/go ./go
env BROWSER=$GOPATH/bin/browser PATH=$TMPDIR:$PATH
go bug
exists $TMPDIR/browser
grep '^url: https://go\.dev/issue/new$' $TMPDIR/browser
grep '^template: 00-bug\.yml$' $TMPDIR/browser
grep '^go-version: go version ' $TMPDIR/browser
grep '^\$ go env$' $TMPDIR/browser
grep '^GOROOT/bin/go version: go version' $TMPDIR/browser
grep '^GOROOT/bin/go tool compile -V: compile version' $TMPDIR/browser
grep '^uname -sr: Linux' $TMPDIR/browser
grep '^-- generated by go bug$' $TMPDIR/browser

# Verify fallback output when opening a browser fails.
env DISPLAY= BROWSER= PATH=$TMPDIR
go bug
stdout 'https://go\.dev/issue/new\?template=00-bug\.yml'
stdout '^go version '
stdout '^-- generated by go bug$'

-- go.mod --
module browser

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func main() {
	u, err := url.Parse(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	q := u.Query()
	out := filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "browser")
	f, err := os.Create(out)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(f, "url: %s://%s%s\n", u.Scheme, u.Host, u.Path)
	fmt.Fprintf(f, "template: %s\n", q.Get("template"))
	fmt.Fprintf(f, "go-version: %s\n", q.Get("go-version"))
	fmt.Fprintln(f, q.Get("go-env"))
	if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

-- go/main.go --
package main

import (
    "os"
)

func main() {
    os.Exit(1)
}
